name: pc-hardware-advisor
description: PC hardware expertise: worldwide landed-price hunting, part compatibility checks, complete builds by need and budget, local-AI machine sizing, used-listing review, deal checks and price tracking.

interface.longDescription: Find the lowest landed price for a PC part with every price dated and sourced, check that parts work together, design a complete build for a need and a budget, size hardware for local AI models, and judge second-hand listings. Reads public retailer pages only; never buys, logs in or contacts a seller.
defaultPrompt: Build me a 1440p gaming PC for 1,500 EUR in France.
